Adventure Awaits in Cave City
Off I-65 and near Mammoth Cave National Park
When traveling to Kentucky’s Cave Capitol, enjoy homestyle hospitality at our Baymont Inn & Suites Cave City hotel. Make the most of a great location off I-65 and easy access to Kentucky’s oldest tourist attraction and a World Heritage site – Mammoth Cave National Park.
-->
We Have What You Need
Enjoy free breakfast, free WiFi, and more
Enjoy a seasonal outdoor pool, free WiFi, ample free large-vehicle parking, and our free daily Baymont Breakfast Corner. Spacious guest rooms feature a microwave, mini-refrigerator, and coffee and tea maker, while suites outfitted with hot tubs boast ultimate comfort.
Explore Our Hometown
Explore exciting caves, learn about dinosaurs, or enjoy a Wild West theme park
We are five minutes from Mammoth Cave, world-renowned as the longest cave system on the planet with over 4,000 miles of passages. Tour both Diamond and Cave Springs caverns, each iconic for their singularly unique formations, or delight in prehistoric-themed fun at Dinosaur World. Visit Funtown Mountain, a Wild West theme park, as well as Smith’s Country Store, home to many local goods and souvenirs.

*New Hotels: 2X Wyndham Rewards Bonus Points Terms & Conditions:
Capitalized terms used without definition in these promotion terms and conditions (“Offer Terms”) will have the meanings ascribed to them in the Wyndham Rewards Program terms and conditions, available at  www.wyndhamhotels.com/wyndham-rewards/terms  (the “Program Terms”). To qualify for the 2X Wyndham Rewards bonus points offer (the “Offer”), a Wyndham Rewards Member must book a stay under the 2X Wyndham Rewards Bonus Points Rate at a participating Wyndham Rewards hotel on any Direct Booking Channel (as defined below) and complete such stay in accordance with the booking. Member must be a Wyndham Rewards Member in good standing to participate.
“Direct Booking Channel” means: any or all of the following: (i) www.wyndhamhotels.com/wyndham-rewards, wyndhamhotels.com or any of the official brand websites of the Hotel Chains; (ii) the official toll-free reservation number of Wyndham Rewards or any of the Hotel Chains by requesting the 2X Wyndham Rewards Bonus Points Rate; (iii) onsite at a participating hotel, directly with such property by requesting the 2X Wyndham Rewards Bonus Points Rate; or (iv) the Wyndham Hotels & Resorts App.
A Member who books and completes a stay in accordance with the Offer Terms will receive 2X the amount of Base Points such Member would have earned for such stay, absent this Offer, pursuant to the Program Terms (the additional points earned by a Member pursuant to these Offer Terms, a “Bonus”). For example, a Qualified Stay that is booked and completed by a Member in accordance with the Offer Terms that would, under the Program Terms, earn 3,000 Base Points would, pursuant to this Offer, earn a total of 6,000 points (2 X 3,000 = 6,000, with 3,000 of such points denominated as Base Points, and the remaining 3,000 points denominated as the Bonus). For clarity, a Member will not receive the Bonus for a no-show.
Restrictions apply. Offer availability limited to participating Wyndham Rewards hotels. Members who have elected in their Member profile to earn airline miles or other Travel Partner Currency rather than Wyndham Rewards points and who book and stay using the Offer will receive their base earning in Travel Partner Currency with the Bonus denominated in Wyndham Rewards points. The Bonus will usually be posted to a Member's account within two to four weeks after the activity through which they were earned. The Offer and its terms and conditions are subject to cancellation or change at any time.
U.S. residents who are not yet Wyndham Rewards Members will be automatically enrolled in the Wyndham Rewards Program; to void enrollment, call Wyndham Rewards member services at 1-866-996-7937. For clarity, Bonus is not available to anyone who is not a Member at the time of its scheduled award.
